slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the demand points, is the demand at each demand point j required to be exactly satisfied (i.e., total quantity received equals b_j), or is it allowed to be less than or equal to b_j (i.e., some demand can be unmet)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must be exactly satisfied or can be unmet, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the fixed cost f_k for a marshaling station incurred only if any positive quantity is transshipped through that station (i.e., a fixed charge that activates the station), and is the objective to minimize the sum of these fixed costs plus all unit transportation costs?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize fixed costs plus unit transportation costs, covering the total-cost minimization objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; it continued repeating the same unresolved question about continuous versus integer shipment quantities through the end of the transcript.

summary: The agent successfully recovered both P0 hidden slots by asking about exact demand satisfaction and the total-cost minimization objective, but then became stuck repeatedly asking an unresolved non-hidden question about continuous versus integer shipment quantities and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
